newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Western Digitial to invest up to $100 mln.
newsitem.headline: Western Digitial to invest up to $100 mln.

text.p: Western Digital Corp plans to invest up to $100 million in Singapore and Malaysia plants by the year 2000 and double disk drive production in those countries, its president, chairman and chief executive officer said on Wednesday.
Charles Haggerty also told Reuters in an interview that total investment in Singapore and Malaysia by 2000 would reach up to $405 million.
"The cumulative investment in Singapore and Malaysia by the year 2000 would be $405 million," Haggerty said.
"Plans are in place to double output in Chai Chee (in Singapore) by end 1998," he also said.
For the next financial year, disk drive output for Singapore and Malaysia is projected to grow from 15.5 million to between 20 and 21 million, he said.
